name: China Hongqiao Group Limited
summary: China Hongqiao Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of aluminum goods across the People's Republic of China and Indonesia. Its product offerings encompass molten aluminum alloys, aluminum alloy ingots, aluminum busbars, specialized aluminum alloy processing, and alumina. Beyond its core aluminum business, the group is actively involved in the research, development, production, and commercialization of bauxite; power generation and supply; port management; the trading of carbons, iron ores, and light alloy materials; railway design and construction; and the provision of financial leasing and strategic business consulting. Established in 1994, the firm maintains its headquarters in Zouping, People's Republic of China, and functions as a subsidiary of China Hongqiao Holdings Limited.
